# The Shadow Legion datasheets

### Every datasheet in the collection, with the numbers and what to do with them

*Generated by `build_datasheets.py` from `data/datasheets.json`, `data/units.json` and `data/lists.json`. Source of the statistics: BSData/wh40k-11e (community BattleScribe data), 6a49fe9 2026-09-06. Characteristics, weapon profiles, points and keywords are facts extracted from that data; every ability, rule, enhancement and stratagem is given as a name and a paraphrase, never the printed text, and the official app is the arbiter for all of it. The strategy paragraphs are this repo's own advice for this collection in the Shadow Legion detachment. The slide-deck edition is `datasheets-deck.html`.*

## How to read a sheet

- The statistics row is Move, Toughness, Save, Wounds, Leadership, Objective Control and the invulnerable save. Weapons list Range, Attacks, skill (BS or WS), Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage; a weapon with two profiles appears twice.
- Abilities marked *detachment boon* are the Shadow Legion's per-god boons, which the current data attaches to each unit as an ability. Abilities marked *wargear* come with an optional item.
- "In the collection" comes from the inventory in `data/units.json`, and "in lists" from `army-lists.md`. Points are the current data's; where they differ from the July 27 audit, `army-lists.md` says so.
- Everything here is a snapshot. Before a tournament, open the app.

## The army rules

- **The Shadow of Chaos.** Your deployment zone is always in shadow; No Man's Land joins it in any phase where you hold at least half of its objectives, and the enemy zone joins when you hold half of theirs. Daemonic Manifestation: a daemon unit in shadow adds 1 to its Battle-shock roll and, on a pass, heals D3 or, if Battleline, returns up to D3 destroyed non-Character models. Daemonic Terror: an enemy unit in shadow, or within 6" of a Greater Daemon, tests Battle-shock at -1 and takes D3 mortal wounds when it fails.
- **Warp Rifts.** A daemon deep-striking wholly inside the shadow, or wholly within 6" of a friendly Greater Daemon of its own god, can be set up more than 6" from the enemy instead of 9".
- **Dark Pacts.** When a unit with it shoots or fights it may take a Leadership test: fail and it suffers D3 mortal wounds, and either way its weapons gain Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1 for the phase. Here Be'lakor and every Heretic Astartes unit have it; Be'lakor passes automatically.
- **Harbingers of Dread.** The Chaos Knights army rule: Dread auras that worsen enemy Leadership near the Knight, growing through the battle. It keys off a Chaos Knights army faction, so as Dreadblades in this army treat it as off unless the app says otherwise.

## The detachment: Shadow Legion (2 DP)

**First Prince of Chaos.** Every unit carries its god's boon as a datasheet ability. Khorne, Murderer's Cowl: Advance and still shoot and charge. Tzeentch, Penumbral Puppetry: Stealth and -1 to be hit in melee. Nurgle, Gloam Rot: -1 to wound when the attack's Strength beats Toughness. Slaanesh, as recorded in July: cannot be Overwatched. Undivided, Disciples of Be'lakor: Dark Pacts, and Deep Strike for Heretic Astartes. Be'lakor must be the Warlord; no Daemon Princes, no vehicles, no Epic Heroes but him; up to half the army from the Thralls of the First Prince allowlist.

| Allegiance | Boon (as an ability on each unit) |
|---|---|
| Khorne | **Murderer's Cowl**: The Khorne boon: this unit can Advance and still shoot and charge in the same turn. |
| Tzeentch | **Penumbral Puppetry**: The Tzeentch boon: Stealth, and melee attacks against this unit hit at -1. |
| Nurgle | **Gloam Rot**: The Nurgle boon: an attack whose Strength beats this unit's Toughness wounds at -1. |
| Undivided | **Disciples of Be'lakor**: The Undivided boon: Dark Pacts (Be'lakor passes the Leadership test automatically), and Deep Strike for Heretic Astartes models. |
| Slaanesh | As recorded in July: cannot be targeted by Fire Overwatch. No Slaanesh unit is owned. |

| Enhancement | Pts | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Leaping Shadows | 25 | The bearer's unit gains Scouts 9": a pre-game move before turn one. |
| Mantle of Gloom (Aura) | 20 | Enemy models in engagement range of the bearer's unit have -1 Objective Control. |
| Fade to Darkness | 30 | At the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer's unit destroyed a unit and is out of engagement range, lift it into Strategic Reserves. The yo-yo. |
| Malice Made Manifest | 25 | At the start of the Fight phase, an enemy unit in engagement range of the bearer's unit takes D3 mortal wounds on a 2 to 5, or 3 on a 6. |

| Stratagem | CP | When | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| Warp Surge | 1 | Charge | A daemon unit inside the shadow can charge after Advancing. Recorded by the July research; not in BattleScribe data; verify. |
| Denizens of the Warp | 1 | Movement (reinforcements) | A deep-striking unit arrives more than 3" from the enemy instead of 9". Recorded by the July research; verify. |
| Binding Shadow | ? | ? | Pull an endangered unit off the board into reserves; the rescue half of the yo-yo. Recorded by the July research with no cost captured; verify. |
| Rapid Ingress (core) | 1 | Enemy Movement | The core stratagem that brings a Faded unit back in the opponent's turn. A Chaos Lord's Lord of Chaos makes it free for his own squad once per round. |

*BattleScribe data carries no stratagems. These are the ones this repo's research recorded; names, costs and timing must be read from the app.*

### Be'lakor — The Source

*390 pts (1) · 1 model · Legiones Daemonica · Monster, Character, Fly, Epic Hero, Psyker, Daemon, Shadow Legion, Undivided.*

**In the collection:** 1 owned, painted. In lists A, B, C, D, E, F, G.

| M | T | Sv | W | Ld | OC | Inv |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12" | 11 | 3+ | 20 | 6+ | 5 | 4+ |

| Ranged weapon | Range | A | BS | S | AP | D | Keywords |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Betraying Shades - witchfire | 18" | 9 | 2+ | 5 | -2 | 1 | Devastating Wounds, Ignores Cover, Psychic |
| Betraying Shades - focused witchfire | 18" | 12 | 2+ | 6 | -3 | 1 | Devastating Wounds, Hazardous, Ignores Cover, Psychic |

| Melee weapon | A | WS | S | AP | D | Keywords |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The Blade of Shadows - sweep | 14 | 2+ | 8 | -3 | 1 | Sustained Hits 1 |
| The Blade of Shadows - strike | 7 | 2+ | 14 | -4 | D6+1 | Devastating Wounds |

**Abilities.**

- **The Dark Master (Aura)**: Everything within 6" of him counts as inside your Shadow of Chaos.
- **Shadow Form**: At the start of each battle round choose one of the three auras below; he has it for the round.
- **Wreathed in Shadows (Aura, Psychic)**: Friendly daemon and Shadow Legion units within 6" can only be shot from within 18".
- **Pall of Despair (Aura, Psychic)**: In the enemy Command phase, enemy units below starting strength within 9" must take a Battle-shock test; he heals D3 for each failure.
- **Shadow Lord (Aura, Psychic)**: Friendly daemon and Shadow Legion units within 6" re-roll hit rolls of 1.
- **Damaged: 1-6 wounds remaining**: At 6 wounds or fewer it hits at -1.
- **Disciples of Be'lakor** *(detachment boon)*: The Undivided boon: Dark Pacts (Be'lakor passes the Leadership test automatically), and Deep Strike for Heretic Astartes models.
- Core: Deep Strike, Stealth, Deadly Demise

**Role.** Warlord, umbrella and shadow engine.

**How to play it.** Round one, Wreathed in Shadows: nothing within 6" of him can be shot from beyond 18", so castle the Horrors, Flamers and Legionaries under his wings and make the enemy walk into the shadow to shoot. Once the fighting starts, Shadow Lord for re-roll 1s across the castle or the strike wave. The round after you have damaged units sitting near objectives, Pall of Despair: forced tests at -1 inside the shadow, D3 mortal wounds per failure, and he heals D3 per failure. He is a fighter second. The strike profile (7 attacks, S14, AP-4, D6+1, Devastating Wounds) kills a Character or a light tank; the sweep (14 attacks, S8, AP-3, Sustained Hits 1) clears infantry. Keep him at 7 or more wounds where you can; at 6 he hits at -1.

**Pairs with.** Legionaries and Possessed, which deep-strike beside him and Dark Pact inside his re-roll aura; the Horrors, whose Manifestation only works inside a shadow; a second monster on the other flank so two bubbles cover the midfield.

**Beware.** Anti-monster shooting inside 18": a 4+ invulnerable and a 3+ save do not survive massed AP-2. Chaff that ties him up away from objectives. He is an Epic Hero, so no enhancement.

### Lord of Change — The Anagnost

*320 pts (1) · 1 model · Legiones Daemonica · Monster, Character, Fly, Psyker, Daemon, Tzeentch, Tzeentch non-Battleline, Shadow Legion.*

**In the collection:** 1 owned, painted. As built: check which melee weapon the painted model carries; every list assumes the staff. In lists A, B, F, G.

| Bolt of Change - focused witchfire | 18" | 9 | 2+ | 9 | -2 | 3 | Hazardous, Psychic |
| Rod of sorcery | 18" | 6 | 2+ | 8 | -1 | 2 | Psychic |

| Melee weapon | A | WS | S | AP | D | Keywords |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Staff of Tzeentch | 5 | 3+ | 6 | -1 | 3 | Psychic |

**Abilities.**

- **Daemon Lord of Tzeentch (Aura)**: Friendly Tzeentch daemons within 6", himself included, add 1 to the Strength of ranged attacks.
- **Master of Magicks (Psychic)**: Each of your Shooting phases, Bolt of Change gains Ignores Cover, Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits D3.
- **Damaged: 1-7 wounds remaining**: At 7 wounds or fewer it hits at -1.
- **Greater Daemon of Tzeentch (Aura)**: Friendly Tzeentch daemons within 6" count as inside the shadow.
- **Penumbral Puppetry** *(detachment boon)*: The Tzeentch boon: Stealth, and melee attacks against this unit hit at -1.
- Core: Deadly Demise, Deep Strike, Stealth

**Wargear options.** Staff of Tzeentch may be swapped for a baleful sword.

**Role.** The army's only real gun and its second shadow bubble.

**How to play it.** Stand him 6" behind the Horrors and Flamers so their flames gain a point of Strength and his bubble covers them, then shoot: Bolt of Change (9 shots, S9 or S10 under his own aura, AP-1) with Lethal Hits into vehicles or Sustained Hits D3 into infantry; the focused profile (AP-2, D3, Hazardous) only when the target is worth a mortal wound to himself; the Rod adds six S8 D2 shots. He flies 12" and deep-strikes, so he can also be the second arrival with Be'lakor. Stealth and the 4+ invulnerable keep him alive, not the 6+ armour.

**Pairs with.** Pink Horrors, Flamers, the Exalted Flamer and the Fateskimmer (all +1 Strength shooting within 6"); Be'lakor for double bubbles.

**Beware.** A 6+ save: volume of fire wounds him on saves alone. Keep him out of melee against anything that hits back; the staff is adequate, not good.

Stand them on the objective you intend to keep, under a monster's bubble, and shoot the flames at whatever closes (S5 under the Lord of Change). ## The Blood Tithe (Khorne)

*The wing bought in August: the hammer, the cavalry, the Fade loop.*

### Bloodthirster — The Unbound Word

*320 pts (1) · 1 model · Legiones Daemonica · Monster, Character, Fly, Daemon, Khorne, Khorne non-Battleline, Shadow Legion.*

**In the collection:** 2 owned, unassembled. A genuine Games Workshop kit, new in box, delivered Sep 4 from Frontline Gaming ($150 landed), plus the Jul 27 3D-printed resin proxy on a 100mm base, which is casual-legal only. Lists assume the Games Workshop kit. As built: both unassembled. Build the Games Workshop kit to the great axe and log which build you glue; the resin copy is the practice build, re-based to 120mm and glued with superglue. In lists E, F.

**Abilities.**

- **Daemon Lord of Khorne (Aura)**: Friendly Khorne daemons within 6", himself included, add 1 to melee hit rolls.
- **Relentless Carnage**: At the end of the Fight phase, pick an enemy unit in engagement range and roll eight dice: each 4+ is a mortal wound.
- **Damaged: 1-6 wounds remaining**: At 6 wounds or fewer it hits at -1.
- **Greater Daemon of Khorne (Aura)**: Friendly Khorne daemons within 6" count as inside the shadow.
- **Murderer's Cowl** *(detachment boon)*: The Khorne boon: this unit can Advance and still shoot and charge in the same turn.
- Core: Deadly Demise, Deep Strike

**Wargear options.** Great axe of Khorne (strike 7 attacks S16 AP-4 D6+2, or sweep) may be swapped for an axe of Khorne (strike 8 attacks S14 AP-4 D3+1, or sweep) paired with either a lash of Khorne or a bloodflail, both 12-inch ranged weapons. The great axe is the anti-tank build the tournament lists run.

**Role.** The Fade loop and the army's anti-tank.

**How to play it.** Great axe strike: 7 attacks on 2+, S16, AP-4, D6+2 damage. That is a tank or a Knight-class model in one activation, then Relentless Carnage rolls eight dice for mortal wounds on whatever is still standing. With Fade to Darkness: arrive, kill, and if nothing else is in engagement range vanish into Strategic Reserves at the end of the phase; Rapid Ingress him back in the opponent's turn for 1 CP. Under the Khorne boon he Advances and still charges, so his threat range is 12" plus D6 plus 2D6. Hellfire breath (D6 Torrent shots) is a footnote; never shoot when you could charge.

**Pairs with.** Bloodletters and Bloodcrushers, which get +1 to hit in melee within 6" and can deep-strike 6" from the enemy beside him under Warp Rifts; a Bloodmaster's brick as the follow-up wave.

**Abilities.**

- **Veterans of the Long War**: In melee, re-roll wound rolls of 1; against a unit on an objective, re-roll any wound roll.
- **Chaos icon** *(wargear)*: Wargear: re-roll the Leadership test for a Dark Pact.

**Wargear options.** Aspiring Champion: bolt pistol may be swapped for a plasma pistol; close combat weapon for an accursed weapon. Any Legionary: boltgun may be swapped for an Astartes chainsword. 1 model per unit: a heavy melee weapon. 1 model per unit: a balefire tome. 1 model per five: boltgun may be swapped for a flamer, meltagun, plasma gun, heavy bolter, lascannon, missile launcher, reaper chaincannon or havoc autocannon. 1 model per unit may carry a chaos icon.

**Role.** The mortal half: objectives, actions, and the yo-yo's body.

**How to play it.** Two fives. One carries Mallex and Fade and does the yo-yo; the other holds the home objective and does actions. In melee against a unit on an objective they re-roll every wound roll, and a Dark Pact adds Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1: that is a real fight for 90 points. The detachment gives them Deep Strike, so either five can start in reserve. Build each five with a heavy weapon and a special (lascannon or heavy bolter, plasma gun), a chainsword or two, and a chaos icon on the squad that makes pacts.

**Pairs with.** Chaos Lord, Master of Possession, Be'lakor's Shadow Lord (Shadow Legion units re-roll 1s under him).

**Beware.** OC2 marines are the best objective holders per point in the army, and T4 W2 dies to everything. The yo-yo squad must never be left in the open after a failed charge. Log the painted loadouts: WYSIWYG.

## Data notes

- Characteristics, weapon profiles, points and keywords are extracted as facts. Ability, rule, enhancement and stratagem entries carry names and hand-written gists only; the official app is the arbiter for the full text.
- Points by size come from the catalogue's cost modifiers; sizes not priced by a modifier are not listed.
- On 2026-09-07 every price here was cross-checked against data/datasheets.json (extracted from BSData/wh40k-11e). The 07-27 derivations for the Chaos Lord (90), Bloodmaster (65), Fade to Darkness (30) and Leaping Shadows (25) were confirmed. Five moved: Skullmaster 75 to 85, Rendmaster 150 to 160, six Bloodcrushers 190 to 200, War Dog Karnivore 155 to 145, and the Great Unclean One is 265. Beasts of Nurgle are 80 for one and 150 for two. build_lists.py refuses to build if this file and datasheets.json disagree.
- Unit sizes are listed only where the audit recorded a price. Most datasheets offer other sizes; read them from the app.
- Wargear names and options are recorded as the datasheets stood when these lists were built. Anything the audit did not confirm carries a verify flag. The app is the arbiter.
- Two Shadow Legion enhancements are recorded (Fade to Darkness, Leaping Shadows). The detachment's remaining enhancements were never captured in this repo; add them here when read from the app.
- The Heretic Astartes cap is carried as the 07-27 ledger applied it: at most half the points, counted without enhancement costs. Verify whether the current wording counts points or units.

---

*The Umbral Creed is original fan fiction for a personal collection. Game statistics here are facts about datasheets as the cited data recorded them, with a verify-in-app caveat and a snapshot date; nothing is copied from Games Workshop publications.*
